units.source_excerpt: The reference list documents geographical profiling, criminology, rational choice, statistical methods, mapping sources, and case-data provenance while leaving implementation code unavailable.
units.function: Define a term and immediately mark what the definition excludes or assumes.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not copy offender names, addresses, coordinates, dates, exact case scores, or source prose into another paper.
Do not treat a physical analogy, utility story, normalized surface, or favorable case as calibrated probability or universal behavioral truth.

features.voice: first-person plural for design and tests; impersonal voice for definitions and equations; direct advisory voice in the executive summary
features.tense: present for mechanism and model; past for historical cases and simulations; conditional for deployment and repair
features.modality: assume, infer, may, can, should, and must preserve different levels of evidential force
features.quantitative_role: attach coordinates, elapsed time, parameter choice, distance, area, hit score, or regression result to its exact case and target

original_instantiations.text: A wildfire brief names the dispatcher, observed ignitions, next-hour hotspot target, and patrol decision before introducing equations.
It closes the opening by separating a moving-front forecast from a long-run origin estimate.
